text:
Avery: Heads up — onboarding new tenant acme-pipeline. Creating a prod nodepool in eastus2 failed: QuotaExceeded when provisioning 8 x Standard_ND40rs_v2. Error in AKS: 'Requested core quota exceeds available cores in region'. Anyone else seeing ND/NC pressure in eastus2?
Ravi: Yup saw spikes yesterday during afternoon. We fell back to NCv3 for a short batch. Not ideal for perf but bought time.
ops-bot: subscription: sub-chi-12345 | resourceGroup: rg-acme-prod | recommended quota request template: https://aka.ms/azure-quota-template | contact: infra-ops@redwood.com
Sam: Filed Azure ticket: 2101984732. Requested ND40rs_v2 quota increase (region: eastus2) from 10 -> 50 and subnet /29 expansion. Added billing contact acc-azure-redwood-prod and linked subscription. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/CaseV2/overview/2101984732
Nora: Do we want capacity reservation (reserved instance / capacity reservation) on top of quota? If we don't reserve we might lose nodes when demand peaks. cc @Ravi
Avery: Yes, we should request both quota and a capacity reservation for a dedicated pool for acme. Sam — can you add a capacity reservation request and estimate cost?
Sam: Done. Added a parallel request for capacity reservation: sku Standard_ND40rs_v2, region eastus2, quantity 8 for initial reserve. Azure assigned case owner Miguel.
Miguel (Azure Support): Thanks, we have the case. Can you provide the subscription GUID (not display id), exact SKU string, target count, and if this is per-VM quota or vCPU quota? Also confirm whether you want quota at subscription scope or subscription+region.
Sam: Provided details: subGUID: fe12ab34-5678-90cd-ef12-3456abcd7890, sku: Standard_ND40rs_v2, target instances: 8 reserved + ability to burst to 24 on quota. Requesting vCPU and regional quota. Also included desired start date for capacity reservation: 2026-04-01.
Avery: Quick cost note: 8 reserved ND40rs_v2 for 1 month equivalent pricing estimate ~ $18k/month (pre-negotiation). If we reserve 6 months that's ~ $100k. Keep finance in loop.
Ravi: Can we reduce initial reservation to 4 and rely on burst? Finance prefers smaller commit first.
Sam: Updated case to reserve 4 initially and retain quota to burst to 24. Azure case notes updated.
deploy-bot: [2026-03-18T15:04:12Z] AKS nodepool creation failed: ProvisioningState: Failed | Reason: QuotaExceeded | Details: 'Cannot provision Standard_ND40rs_v2 in eastus2; coresRequested=160; coresAvailable=120'
Nora: That deploy log confirms cores > available. We should also open a networking limit request — subnets /29 -> /27 for the cluster. Sam, can you add that to the same case?
Sam: Added subnet expansion to case 2101984732, requested /27 for rg-acme-prod-vnet. Azure accepted as part of extension.
Miguel (Azure Support): We are prioritizing given reserved capacity request. Preliminary ETA: quota increase within 24-48h, capacity reservation approval may take 72h pending regional capacity checks. Will update with provisioning timeline.
Avery: Thanks. Once quota is approved, we need a runbook: 1) retry nodepool create 2) if still fails fallback to NCv3 3) alert customers. Sam/Nora please draft short runbook and post here.
Sam: Drafted runbook gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123 — includes AKS retry command, scale steps, and notification copy.
Ravi: Also raise a billing hold fallback option: if cost > threshold, auto-fallback to cheaper SKU. Who owns that? @Avery or @Finance?
Avery: I'll own fallback policy for now; coordinate with Finance for thresholds.
Miguel (Azure Support): Update: Quota increased: ND40rs_v2 regional vCPU quota bumped to target values. Capacity reservation pending final sign-off; expected by 2026-03-20. Ticket 2101984732 updated.
Sam: Confirmed — I retried the nodepool create, initial 4 nodes provisioned, cluster green. We'll keep monitoring and will only expand when capacity reservation confirmed.
Nora: Great. Please tag me when capacity reservation is confirmed so we can run our load ramp tests.
Avery: Closing loop: Sam to update ticket with final confirmation and post final notes here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
